scope: standalone scalar local chains; no Java, population algorithm or HV changes
normalization: initial parent objective vector fixed for the whole chain and all paired methods
acceptance: strict normalized scalar improvement >1e-10; true full decode only; FA fixed
pool: exactly v2 legal_local distribution/order, but materialize only the chosen 16 descriptors; verified equal
controls: cut_time shares exact dynamic-fatigue stage0, stops downstream fatigue adjoints; local_time is v1 cheap time-channel; random uniform on identical pool rule
candidate_truth: one selected child fully decoded per decision, including rejected children; no all-candidate oracle
cache: lazy keyed by parent version+genome; invalidate on every acceptance, reuse on rejection only; all construction and hit costs timed
reuse_definition: q counts first use plus subsequent scored pools; accepted epochs and terminal right-censored epochs reported separately
time_measurement: perf_counter_ns around initialization, trace/minimal decode, RNG, generation, cache setup, exact stage0 or defects, selection, selected decode, acceptance and in-memory audit logging
excluded_time: common instance loading, output JSON serialization/disk I/O, offline final QA and separate component calibration; separately accounted, no oracle data in search
deadline: non-preemptive decisions; only accept children whose full decode finishes on/before deadline; report overrun and actual elapsed, include overrun in measured gain/second
equal_FE: 24 decisions => 25 adaptive full evaluations incl initial for all primary methods; partial stage0 calls and their time count separately
run_order: deterministic rotating method order in each profile/target/budget block; sequential single-thread
paired_randomness: same initial genome, step-indexed pool seeds and choice RNG; pools may differ after accepted parents diverge
calibration: none: unchanged kernels already timed in v4; expanded numerical gate and all108 full/incremental fixed controls retained
ablation: cut_time_full is FULL first-stage scoring with the same downstream time boundary; every selector still fully decodes selected children

statistics.primary_family: 8 directional contrasts: 2 budgets x 4 controls; one-sided instance-mean paired sign-flip p values with Holm adjustment across all8
statistics.intervals: hierarchical instance->seed paired bootstrap95, unadjusted effect intervals; instance wins/ties/losses with tolerance1e-10
statistics.strata: N=20/50/100/150/200 and prior6 versus new30 instances, descriptive, no threshold/seed/budget selection
statistics.secondary: all positive and negative cells reported; exploratory, no adjusted superiority assertion

incremental: same-factory tokens (job,machine,worker); reuse exact identical prefix and all unaffected factories; recompute every changed-factory suffix op; no convergence approximation
cache_cost: build checkpoint lists from paid parent trace, no extra parent decode; include build, all candidate validation/copies/scans/sums and projections in online wall clock
numerical_contract: C/v and direct-cost addition order exactly match v3 full stage0; fixed-budget score/choice/accept trajectories must match full references
repeat_statistics: one timing run per method/case/budget; 108 paired parents in 36 independent instance clusters, not 108 independent instances
preservation: new validation then performance directories, protocol and all five packages frozen; no Java/full algorithm changes
fixed_control: 24 decisions, cut_time versus cut_time_full, all 108 strong-fast TEC new-seed parents; bitwise score/choice/accept/final equality required before time trials for that parent
data_mapping: original6 keep v1-v4 setup/profile seed indices; remaining30 append in sorted manifest order; preserve old data, no cherry-picked new SUT
